review_text_raw:
This game is very interesting. It let's you feel like a hacker.
The way the story is given to you is intriguing.
And holy hell does this game make me uncomfortable.
But that's the beauty of this game. It's not afraid to go there. 
Especially the dlc, Home Sweet Home. 
That one made me hella uncomfortable.

But story aside, I love the was you need to gather information and how you can put the pieces together. it's super fun.

The only downside to this game is how short it is, but I get it. They need to work with the things they have.

But yeah. other than that.
I remember at one point in the game, it froze on me and I was forced to restart my whole computer. I bet that wasn't supposed to happen, but oh my god did it feel immersive as fuck. I thought I was hacked. Maybe I did get hacked and I didn't know about it, but oh my god did it scare the hell out of me.
